description: This file contains unit test code for dump analysis in the breakpad crash reporting system, including class DumpAnalysis with methods for memory and stream inspection.

classes.name: DumpAnalysis
classes.description: Class providing methods to analyze minidump files, including memory and stream access.

methods.name: ~DumpAnalysis
methods.description: Destructor that unmaps and closes dump file handles.

methods.name: EnsureDumpMapped
methods.description: Maps the dump file into memory if not already mapped.

methods.name: HasTebs
methods.description: Checks if the dump contains Thread Environment Block (TEB) information.

methods.name: HasPeb
methods.description: Checks if the dump contains Process Environment Block (PEB) information.

methods.name: HasStream
methods.description: Checks if a specific dump stream is present.

methods.name: GetStreamImpl
methods.description: Retrieves a dump stream by its number.

methods.name: HasMemoryImpl
methods.description: Checks if a memory range exists in the dump for a given address and size.
